correctness.rationale: The repaired graph is exactly the XOR model with neighbors at Hamming distances one and four. The character eigenvalues 4−2w+(−1)^w give 5 once, 1 ten times and −3 five times. Thus A−I is admissible with real nullity ten; the row equation for each force makes restriction to a forcing set injective in the kernel of any admissible matrix. The legal size-ten witness was independently checked on both waves, so M=Z=10. Any four generators form a basis and the sum is zero. Every nonroot non-neighbor has a distinct pair of root-neighbor adjacencies, so root image and root-neighbor action determine a unique extension. In the replay all permitted root/neighbor permutations were checked against adjacencies, giving the full order 1920. In the dynamic scan each strictly shrinking white mask refers to its already evaluated successor; this exhausts all 65536 labelings and yields the seven displayed cardinality counts, total 9961 and the exact synchronous table. Only the 3872 sets of size ten survive every single-deletion test; by monotonicity this is exactly the inclusion-minimal family. All 18 orbit certificate rows including stall/finish time and first-wave size match, with the stated seven success rows and representatives. The replacement and slogan state only verified counts and times, and use the unchanged verifier artifacts and verification notes.
residual_risks: These are ordinary forcing results on the five-regular graph alone. The propagation table is for simultaneous rounds, not for an arbitrary scheduler. The real nullity result does not concern the binary rank or PSD maximum nullity.

value.rationale: Forcing from all larger initial sets is not settled by knowing the optimum masks. An all-size and all-round census of this canonical folded cube gives a complete robustness benchmark; well-forcedness identifies exactly which generators of the monotone family are needed, and the two-round stopping bound describes every successful set. The known count of minimum sets, graph-normalization facts and optimum orbit data by themselves are not the novelty or value basis.
residual_risks: No claim about all folded cubes, other initial palettes, or general mechanisms for synchronous propagation times.
